4501.title: Missing Project chip in plugin-embedded ThreadChat
4501.rootCauseOneLine: PluginThreadChat omits projectName from ThreadEnvironmentSummary; real renderer hides the chip without it.
4501.proposedFix: Resolve project display name and pass it into embedded summary; add named-project/loading controls.
